popia.title: Your Privacy, Your Rights
popia.intro: Vulindlela is committed to protecting your personal information. We follow the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA).

who_we_are.title: 1. Who we are
who_we_are.content: Vulindlela is the Responsible Party. Our Information Officer can be reached at privacy@vulindlela.org.za.

what_we_collect.title: 2. What we collect
what_we_collect.content: We only collect what we need: your name, mobile number, town, skills, and language preference. We never ask for ID numbers or bank details.

why_we_collect.title: 3. Why we collect it
why_we_collect.content: To match you with opportunities, verify employers, and keep you safe from scams.

who_sees_it.title: 4. Who sees your data
who_sees_it.content: Employers only see what you choose to share. We never sell your data.

protection.title: 5. How we protect it
protection.content: Your data is encrypted and stored securely.

rights.title: 6. Your Rights
rights.content: You can see, change, or delete your data at any time. You can also complain to the Information Regulator.

under_18.title: 7. If you are under 18
under_18.content: Users aged 15–17 need a parent or guardian's permission via OTP.

camera.title: 8. Camera and Gestures
camera.content: If you use hand-gestures, video is processed on your device only and never saved.

popia.consent_processing: I agree to Vulindlela processing my information to run my account. (Required)
popia.consent_employer: I agree to share my profile with verified employers. (Optional)
popia.consent_alerts: I agree to receive opportunity alerts. (Optional)

shield.detector_desc: Paste a job listing or message below to check for red flags.
